issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Dedica
products.tagline: Check if AI agents can use your website
products.summaryZh: 检查AI代理是否可以使用你的网站
products.descriptionZh: Dedica 以 AI 智能体使用网站的方式测试你的网站，然后针对每一处失败为你的团队提供修复方案。Muse、Instinct、GrokBot 等智能体现在可以代替人们浏览、比较和注册。Dedica 运行 125 项检查（免费），以确认它们能否使用你的网站，并针对每个问题给出修复方案，供你交给编码智能体处理。
products.description: Dedica tests your website the way AI agents use it, then gives your team a fix for every place they fail. Muse, Instinct, GrokBot and other agents now browse, compare and sign up on people's behalf. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.

products.name: bytemail
products.tagline: Native Mac email: every inbox, in your notch, no trackers
products.summaryZh: 原生 Mac 邮件：所有收件箱，尽在刘海，无追踪器
products.descriptionZh: bytemail 是一款用 Swift 构建的原生 Mac 电子邮件应用。Gmail、iCloud、Outlook、Yahoo、Fastmail 以及任何 IMAP 账户都汇聚在一个快速窗口中。新邮件和登录验证码从 MacBook 的刘海处弹出，撤销发送会让纸飞机穿过刘海，桌面小组件显示未读内容。跟踪像素被拦截，仿冒发件人被标记，你的邮件绝不会经过我们的服务器。支持稍后提醒、规则、一键退订，以及面向 Claude 和其他 AI 应用的 MCP 服务器。包含 iPhone 测试版。7 天免费试用。
products.description: bytemail is a native Mac email app built in Swift. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one fast window. New mail and sign-in codes grow out of your MacBook's notch, Undo Send flies a paper plane through it, and desktop widgets show what's unread. Tracking pixels are blocked, look-alike senders flagged, and your mail never touches our servers. Snooze, rules, one-click unsubscribe, and an MCP server for Claude and other AI apps. iPhone beta included. 7-day free trial.

products.name: BotGauge
products.tagline: The trust layer for your agents
products.summaryZh: 为你的智能体提供信任层
products.descriptionZh: AI 智能体不再只是生成答案。它们会执行操作、调用工具并访问真实数据。BotGauge 帮助工程团队在用户之前发现智能体失效的位置。运行自适应红队攻击和评估，捕获安全与行为故障，并通过完整追踪回放每个问题。将故障转化为回归测试，随着智能体演进持续重测，并在生产环境中监控其行为。从开发到部署的一体化可靠性层。
products.description: AI agents don't just generate answers anymore. They take actions, call tools, and access real data. BotGauge helps engineering teams find where agents break before users do. Run adaptive red-team attacks and evals, catch security and behavioral failures, and replay every issue with full traces. Turn failures into regression tests, continuously retest as your agents evolve, and monitor their behavior in production. One reliability layer from development to deployment.

products.name: Fraud Blocker
products.tagline: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads
products.summaryZh: 面向 Google 和 Meta 广告的 AI 广告欺诈防护
products.descriptionZh: Fraud Blocker 是一个 AI 驱动的平台，可拦截来自机器人、点击农场和 AI 代理的无效广告流量，确保企业、营销人员和代理机构只为真实点击和真实线索付费。它使用基于数十亿次点击和 IP 训练的 AI 代理，识别传统过滤器遗漏的复杂无效流量，并解释每次点击或 IP 被拦截的原因。这有助于保护预算、提升转化质量并减少浪费的广告支出。
products.description: Fraud Blocker is an AI-powered platform that blocks invalid ad traffic from bots, click farms, and AI agents, ensuring enterprises, marketers, and agencies pay only for real clicks and genuine leads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

products.name: Tulu
products.tagline: Autonomous marketing operations & analytics for SMBs
products.summaryZh: 面向中小企业的自主营销运营与分析
products.descriptionZh: 告别手动操作，无需再处理UTM参数、电子表格或任何其他繁琐事务，即可获得准确答案。了解营销支出在哪里产生收入，并在真正需要你关注时，将提醒直接发送到WhatsApp。整合线下支出，分享视图以协调整个团队，最终不再凭猜测安排预算。获取真正重要的洞察，从而精确决定下一笔欧元该投向哪里。
products.description: Say ta-ta to manual work, and get the right answers without messing with UTMs, spreadsheets or...anything else. See where marketing spend produces revenue, and get alerts straight to WhatsApp when something actually needs your attention. Integrate offline spend, share views to align the entire team, and finally stop guessing with your budget. Get to the insights that matter, so you can decide exactly where to put your next euro.

products.name: Trigger.dev: Webhooks for your AI agents
products.tagline: Run AI agents with Slack, Supabase and 50+ other services
products.summaryZh: 使用 Slack、Supabase 及其他 50 多种服务运行 AI 智能体
products.descriptionZh: Trigger.dev Webhooks 让你能在客户已在使用的服务之上构建 AI 代理，例如 Slack、Supabase 和 Stripe。一个 GitHub 拉取请求可以启动代码审查代理，一个新的 Sentry 问题可以启动编写修复的代理，而 Stripe 退款可以等待人工在 Slack 中批准。
products.description: Trigger.dev Webhooks let you build AI agents on top of the services your customers already use, like Slack, Supabase and Stripe. A GitHub pull request can start a code review agent, a new Sentry issue can start an agent that writes the fix, and a Stripe refund can wait for a human to approve it in Slack.

products.name: LFM3 by Liquid AI
products.tagline: Six 2B-class models for phones, laptops and robots
products.summaryZh: 六款2B级模型，适用于手机、笔记本电脑和机器人
products.descriptionZh: LFM3 是 Liquid AI 的第三代 Liquid Foundation Models，采用开放权重，并在文本、视觉、音频、全模态和决策模型之间共享同一骨干。首个发布包含六个 2B 级模型，其中包括一个 1.7B 文本模型，4-bit 量化下约占 1 GB，并具有 256K 上下文。Liquid 表示，这些模型可在手机、笔记本电脑和边缘设备上运行，并能在单块 GPU 上微调。权重已在 Hugging Face 上发布。
products.description: LFM3 is Liquid AI’s third generation of Liquid Foundation Models, with open weights and a shared backbone across text, vision, audio, omni and decision models. The first release is six 2B-class models, including a 1.7B text model that fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit and has a 256K context. Liquid says they run on phones, laptops and edge devices and can be fine-tuned on one GPU. Weights are on Hugging Face.

products.name: App Store Screenshots
products.tagline: Your coding agent designs your app store screenshots
products.summaryZh: 你的编程智能体为你的应用商店截图做设计
products.descriptionZh: 一个免费、开源的技能，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor。把你的应用截图和简短说明交给智能体，它就会在你的项目中构建一个本地截图编辑器。可从 18 种样式中选择，在 Style Lab 中比较外观，编辑文案，并导出 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和 Android 的各种尺寸，支持多种语言。无需截图订阅。它在本地运行；你常用的智能体费用照常适用。安装：npx skills add ParthJadhav/app-store-screenshots
products.description: A free, open-source skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Give your agent your app captures and a short brief, and it builds a local screenshot editor in your project. Choose from 18 styles, compare looks in Style Lab, edit the copy, and export every size for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android, in multiple languages. No screenshot subscription. It runs locally; your usual agent costs apply. Install: npx skills add ParthJadhav/app-store-screenshots

products.name: Genie 4
products.tagline: Turn a prompt into a living world you can steer
products.summaryZh: 将提示词转化为一个可操控的鲜活世界
products.descriptionZh: Genie 4 是 Google DeepMind 面向创作者、游戏开发者和 AI 研究人员推出的全新实时世界模型。与直接交付成品视频的视频生成器不同，Genie 4 构建的是一个可在运行中用键盘行走、用文本操控的世界：改变天气、添加角色、触发事件。它能生成原生音频和实时对话，模拟物理效果与自然人体运动，并借助 Gemini 保持场景连贯。目前为研究预览版，候补名单已开放。
products.description: Genie 4 is Google DeepMind’s new real-time world model for creators, game developers and AI researchers. Unlike video generators that hand you a finished clip, Genie 4 builds a world you walk through with your keyboard and steer with text as it runs: change the weather, add a character, set an event in motion. It generates native audio and live dialogue, simulates physics and natural human motion, and uses Gemini to keep scenes coherent. Research preview, waitlist open now.

products.name: Zro: Uncensored Security Models
products.tagline: Abliterated open models for security work
products.summaryZh: 用于安全工作的开源模型已被彻底移除
products.descriptionZh: 安全研究常常涉及通用模型会拒绝回答的问题。认识一下 Dolly 1 Security 和 Dolly 2 Security，它们是 GLM-5.3 Flash 和 GLM-5.3 的未审查变体，用于防御性测试和红队工作流。通过 Zro API 或 CLI 运行它们，零请求留存。自我们 7 月上线以来，还新增了模型、智能体集成、年度套餐和推荐奖励。
products.description: Security research often involves questions that general-purpose models refuse Meet Dolly 1 Security and Dolly 2 Security, uncensored variants of GLM-5.3 Flash and GLM-5.3 for defensive testing and red-team workflows. Run them through the Zro API or CLI with zero request retention. Since our July launch, we’ve also added new models, agent integrations, yearly plans, and referrals.

products.name: OpenLLM
products.tagline: Take your AI tokens anywhere
products.summaryZh: 随身携带你的AI代币
products.descriptionZh: 把你的 token 带到任何地方。在 Codex 和任何编码 agent 中使用你的订阅、API 密钥和本地模型，或在 Mac 上的 ChatGPT 应用内使用。达到限制后仍会继续运行。从任何地方在你家里的机器上启动编码会话。
products.description: Take your tokens anywhere. Use your subscriptions, API keys and local models in Codex and any coding agent, or inside the ChatGPT app on your Mac. Hit a limit and it keeps going. Start a coding session on your home machine from anywhere.

products.name: Hob
products.tagline: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 开源的、设备上的Claude和ChatGPT替代品
products.descriptionZh: Hob 是一款免费、开源的 AI 应用，支持 Mac、Windows 和 Linux，能像 ChatGPT 和 Claude 那样处理你的文件，区别在于 AI 运行在你自己的电脑上。它会挑选你的电脑能运行的最佳开源模型并为你完成设置。Hob 可以读取和编辑你选定文件夹中的文件，将电子表格转换为图表，填写 PDF，查看照片并搜索网络。你的聊天记录和文件都保留在你的电脑上，并且可以离线使用。
products.description: Hob is a free, open-source AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works with your files the way ChatGPT and Claude do, except the AI runs on your own computer. It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.

products.name: throxy
products.tagline: Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered.
products.summaryZh: 用潜在客户的语言进行冷呼叫。销售管道已交付。
products.descriptionZh: throxy是Y Combinator首家AI原生销售代理，为面向制造业、物流、建筑等通用外联难以奏效行业的B2B公司预约合格销售会议。我们用专有技术构建名单，再由销售代表致电你的买家。本月新增：电话会转接给会说线索所用语言的销售开发代表，因此里昂的工厂经理听到法语，慕尼黑的买家听到德语。你只为接受且实际发生的会议付费。[所有销售开发代表均为真人]
products.description: throxy is Y Combinator's first AI native sales agency, booking qualified sales meetings for B2B companies selling into industries where generic outreach fails: manufacturing, logistics, construction. We build lists using proprietary tech, then our sales reps call your buyers. New this month: calls routed to an SDR who speaks the lead's language, so a plant manager in Lyon hears French + a buyer in Munich hears German. You pay for meetings you accept that actually happen. [All SDRs are humans]

products.name: WebAI by Opera
products.tagline: Let websites use AI running on your computer
products.summaryZh: 让网站使用在你电脑上运行的 AI
products.descriptionZh: 你现在可以使用浏览器内置的本地 AI，开始创建自己的浏览器功能，而不再依赖他人的扩展。
products.description: You can now access local AI built into the browser to start creating your own browser capabilities instead of relying on others' extensions.

products.name: Dotverse
products.tagline: Your Dot now with a crew
products.summaryZh: 你的Dot现在配备了团队
products.descriptionZh: 一款适用于ChatGPT中现有Dot的Mac应用。创建一支拥有不同角色和个性的团队。
products.description: A Mac app for your existing Dot in ChatGPT. Create a crew with different roles and personalities.

products.name: AirPosture
products.tagline: Now on Mac, with a voice coach in your AirPods
products.summaryZh: 现在Mac上也能用，AirPods里有你的语音教练
products.descriptionZh: 自3月发布以来的新增功能：一款驻留菜单栏并通过刘海提示你的Mac应用，一位通过AirPods语音指导你的语音教练，以及在你手机锁屏时仍持续工作的指导。AirPosture将AirPods中的运动传感器变成姿态教练。当你的头部前倾时，一个平静的声音会帮助你重新坐直。此外还有30秒重置和每周姿态视图，iPhone与Mac同步。每天免费使用2小时。
products.description: New since our March launch: a Mac app that lives in the menu bar and cues you from the notch, a voice coach that speaks in your AirPods, and coaching that keeps working with your phone locked. AirPosture turns the motion sensors in your AirPods into a posture coach. When your head drifts forward, a calm voice helps you sit back up. Plus 30-second resets and a weekly view of your posture, with iPhone and Mac in sync. Free for 2 hours a day.

products.name: licenseal
products.tagline: Catch incompatible dependency licenses before release
products.summaryZh: 在发布前捕获不兼容的依赖许可证
products.descriptionZh: 一款免费、开源的CLI，可在10个生态系统中，对照项目的许可证，检查每个依赖项的许可证，包括传递依赖。它读取锁文件和注册表元数据，不安装任何内容，并为CI给出结论，而非列表。
products.description: A free, open-source CLI that checks every dependency license, transitive ones included, against your project's license, in 10 ecosystems. It reads lockfiles and registry metadata, installs nothing, and gives CI a verdict, not a list.

products.name: Basedash View-only members
products.tagline: Share dashboards with anyone. They can look, not edit.
products.summaryZh: 与任何人分享仪表板。他们可以查看，但不能编辑。
products.descriptionZh: 邀请利益相关者、客户或整个部门以仅查看成员身份加入 Basedash。他们可以打开你分享的仪表板、已保存图表、自动化和聊天记录，运行已保存图表，使用仪表板筛选和钻取，并导出结果。他们无法创建或编辑任何内容、运行自动化或聊天。可在邀请对话框、成员设置、API 或嵌入登录令牌中选择角色。分享数据，而非编辑按钮。
products.description: Invite stakeholders, clients, or a whole department to Basedash as view-only members. They can open the dashboards, saved charts, automations, and chat history you share with them, run saved charts, use dashboard filters and drilldowns, and export results. They can't create or edit anything, run automations, or chat. Pick the role in the invite dialog, member settings, the API, or an embed sign-in token. Share the numbers, not the edit button.

products.name: OneDeploy
products.tagline: Open-source apps on your own server, with no per-seat fees
products.summaryZh: 在自己的服务器上运行开源应用，无需按席位付费
products.descriptionZh: 在只属于你的服务器上运行开源应用，无需按席位付费。从105个应用中选择一个并选定区域，查看确切价格，几分钟后它便会在自己的服务器上运行，配有网址、TLS证书和每晚加密的异地备份。你可以添加自己的域名，并通过仪表板进行更新、调整规格或迁移区域。服务器按小时计费，每月设有上限。价格随服务器而定，而非随员工人数而定。
products.description: Run open-source apps on a server that's only yours, without per-seat fees. Pick one of 105 apps and a region, see the exact price, and a few minutes later it runs on its own server with a web address, TLS certificate and nightly encrypted off-site backups. Add your own domain, update, resize or move region from the dashboard. You pay for the server by the hour, capped monthly. The price follows the server, not your headcount.

products.name: TONKO
products.tagline: Pocket money app that teaches kids about money
products.summaryZh: 教孩子认识金钱的零花钱应用
products.descriptionZh: 一款面向家庭的零花钱应用：孩子通过做家务赚取零花钱，把每一欧元分入消费、储蓄和成长三个罐子，为目标存钱，并通过简短课程学习理财技能——每一步都由家长批准。无广告，无需银行卡。Android 版免费。
products.description: A pocket money app for families: kids earn through jobs, split every euro into Spend, Save and Grow jars, save for goals and learn money skills in short lessons — a parent approves every step. No ads, no bank card. Free on Android.
